source_pool: intersection of original raw binding tokens with the exact permitted fit TRAIN view
raw_preprocessing: physical HDF5 event slice, full resolution rasterization, frozen clock and TRAIN normalization
filesystem_cache: warm OS/HDF5 caches; no claim of cold storage or sequential streaming latency
cache_parity: all16 tokens must match contexts, times and sensor support exactly; comparison occurs outside measured interval
parameter_reporting: all instantiated parameters plus active parameters; never treat one standalone as the full multi-expert router
flops_policy: do not infer FLOPs from parameter count; explicitly identify unmeasured operations
